body: The collab of a lifetime Back in 2014, joined as they performed “Engine No. 9” at Australia’s Big Day Out. “I ran over to the Deftones stage and came out as [his alter ego] Delusional Thomas, over some wild sh*t,” the late rapper said. There’s not much footage online, so treasure what we have. : Melodious Minds/YT.

The collab of a lifetime 🤯

Back in 2014, @macmiller joined @deftones as they performed “Engine No. 9” at Australia’s Big Day Out. “I ran over to the Deftones stage and came out as [his alter ego] Delusional Thomas, over some wild sh*t,” the late rapper said.

There’s not much footage online, so treasure what we have.
